items.answer: Instructors hold office hours shown on each LMS course page. Academic Advisors: Mon–Fri 14:00–16:00 IST in Block A Advising Lounge. Book longer sessions via the Advising portal.
Submit an Academic Change Request within 10 days of term start. Your Program Coordinator reviews section capacity and confirms by email within 3 working days.
Open Grades in the LMS student menu, or ask this copilot “What are my grades?” for a snapshot. Attempt-level detail stays in the LMS gradebook.
If your instructor assigned Practice after a check, it appears in your Student Work Queue with a plain-language reason. Complete it there — this chatbot will not teach the concept.
Request a replacement at Campus Hub with a government ID. First replacement is free; further replacements may include a processing fee.
Main library is open 08:00–21:00 IST on weekdays and 10:00–18:00 on Saturdays. Bring your student ID to borrow materials.
Tuition deadlines are on the Finance portal. Installment plans must be approved before the first due date. Contact finance@campus.edu — not your mentor — for payment plans.
Start with Student Success Desk (success@campus.edu). For LMS login issues use IT Support. For teaching content open the course — do not use this chat as a tutor.
